javascript: Needed to open it: @ggds/js turns the link into a button that opens the dialog, and closes it with data-ggds-dialog-close. Without it, the link goes to a confirmation page.
classes: On a <dialog>: a box over the page, opened as a modal.
For an action that cannot be undone: an orange line at the top.
The heading, named by the dialog's aria-labelledby.
The buttons, the safe one first.
states: The dialog is showing, over a darkened page.
